info.title: Cascade CTL Agent API
info.description: Clear-To-List evaluation service. Submit an asset id and receive a verdict (Clear, ClearWithConditions, NotClear, NeedsHumanReview) along with evidence trail, conditions, reflection log, and audit session id. Internally orchestrates a Plan → Investigation (Legal/Valuation/Occupancy) → Reflection → Quality Gate pipeline backed by Azure OpenAI, MCP tools, RAG over policy knowledge, and content/PII guardrails.

post.summary: Run a Clear-To-List evaluation for an asset
post.description: Synchronously runs the full multi-agent CTL pipeline for the supplied asset id and returns the final verdict. Typical latency: 15–40 seconds. Each call emits CTL.AuditStep customEvents to Application Insights.

500.description: Pipeline failure. See returned detail and App Insights for the failed session id.

assetId.description: Asset identifier to evaluate (e.g. ASSET-NY-004, ASSET-TX-001).

requestedBy.description: Caller identifier for audit. Defaults to 'Cascade.CTL.Agent.Api'.

sessionId.description: Audit session id; query App Insights customEvents where customDimensions.SessionId == this.
